label: GO after a1->S1 rewarded; larger if S2 was reached two trials back, and earlier in episode
short_terms: (phase == GO) * last_is("a1 S1 r") ;; (phase == GO) * last_is("a1 S1 r") * ep_trial ;; (phase == GO) * last_is("a1 S1 r") * (tv("state", -2) == 2)
terms: (phase == GO) * last_is("a1 S1 r") ;; (phase == GO) * last_is("a1 S1 r") * ep_trial ;; (phase == GO) * last_is("a1 S1 r") * (tv("reward", -2) == 1) ;; (phase == GO) * last_is("a1 S1 r") * (tv("reward", -3) == 1) ;; (phase == GO) * last_is("a1 S1 r") * (tv("action", -2) == 1) * (tv("state", -2) == 1) ;; (phase == GO) * last_is("a1 S1 r") * (tv("action", -2) == 1) * (tv("state", -2) == 2) ;; (phase == GO) * last_is("a1 S1 r") * belief_lo ;; (phase == GO) * (prev_action == -1)
explanation: Fires only at GO, and almost only when the previous trial was a1 -> S1 (common) rewarded (about 0 after every other pattern and at D1/D2). Within those GO steps the magnitude falls over the episode (beyond the shared timing baseline) and is largest when that reward is fresh evidence for S1: the trial before reached S2 (often a1 rare -> S2), or was unrewarded; it shrinks over a run of repeated rewards (reward two and three back lower it). Belief_lo adds a little positive slope. The free fit adds reward two/three back, splits the two-back a1 trial by state, and adds belief_lo, going from about 0.34 to 0.38 dev. A remaining miss is the window first trial, where the previous trial is unknown. Uses only observed variables.
